environment: Node v22.23.1, Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.0.1 arm64, shared uncontrolled host load

profile.scope: Whole process, unlike the simulate timer. Includes startup/hashing. timeDelta-weighted stack samples under uncontrolled scheduling, not CPU-cycle accounting.
profile.classification: Decode bundled function start coordinates via baseline build source map, before rebuilding changes (which deletes old chunks/maps). Sum timeDeltas once with precedence: GC leaf; any vbic.ts frame in baseline lines 171-475 => evaluation; VBIC charge method or line >=684 => charge work excluding nested evaluation; VBIC stamp/nodeJacobian or any stamp-prefixed frame => stamping; solver/matrix/sparse source or solve/refactorWithPivots => matrix; harness line >=16 => hashing; result/output source or pushResults function => output; remainder other. Output/hash had no separately attributable samples, not proof of zero work. Unresolved/inlined/native work remains other. GC cannot be attributed causally to an allocating subsystem. Evaluation includes arithmetic and allocation, not a separate allocation-only measurement.

tests.red: Before production edits, baseline stamp hash passed; allocation test failed (81440 >=70000).
tests.green: Both new tests and all existing VBIC tests pass.
tests.allocationMeasurement: Explicit numeric-length Array constructions in public-device workload, not all heap allocations or bytes.

commands: spice-heavy node benchmarks/performance/dff-1310.mjs 3 # baseline and rebuilt changed core
pnpm -C packages/core exec vitest run src/devices/vbic-allocation.test.ts # RED on baseline
pnpm -C packages/core exec vitest run src/devices/vbic # GREEN
